compute_locations_for_objects: use ComputeLocations to compute origin and offsets for placing objects relative to a player in Minecraft
compute_location_heuristic_between: compute the midpoint location between two reference objects using compute_location_heuristic with reldir BETWEEN
compute_location_heuristic_inside: find a location inside a reference object using compute_location_heuristic with reldir INSIDE
compute_location_heuristic_directional: compute a location relative to the player using compute_location_heuristic with directional reldir like LEFT or RIGHT
get_repeat_arrangement_circle: get circular placement offsets around a central object using get_repeat_arrangement with repeat_dir AROUND
